PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_auto_capture_bacs_bank_transfer: connector code bug, not a test-data issue: the transformer routes bacs_bank_transfer through Stripe's customer_balance payment type (EUR/USD only) while also setting bank_transfer[type]=gb_bank_transfer (GBP only) — Stripe rejects every currency because the two nested constraints it validates are mutually exclusive. Needs a fix in connectors/stripe/transformers.rs's BacsBankTransfer arm, tracked separately.
PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_manual_capture_incremental_auth: Stripe sandbox account limitation, not a code or test-data issue: Stripe rejects the request with payment_intent_invalid_parameter — "This account is not eligible for the requested card features" — incremental authorization must be enabled on the Stripe account by Stripe support before this can be certified.
